translated: Just when I thought the silver tape shot out with a bang, you all appeared from the sky...
Honami told me you'd be appearing from the sky, but I never expected it to look so much like a magic trick.
We didn't actually appear from the sky, you know.
We were suspended at the very top of the parade float out of sight, and then lowered down all at once.
At the same time, we set up several gas-powered cannons to shoot metallic tape into the air,
making it look as if we suddenly dropped out of the sky.
Though being suspended up there was a bit scary.
But seeing the audience's reaction made it all worth it.
You look so quiet, Kusanagi, but you've actually got a lot of guts.
speaking of which, Hanasato and her group were amazing too, right?
They really got the crowd pumped up with that. It was so cool.
Where did Haruka and the others go?
Mizuki disappeared before I even noticed, too.
I heard Rui flubbed his line.
So this is where you all gathered.
Oh, we were actually holding a mini handshake event until just now.
Momojan asked the staff to set aside a space
so they could interact with all their fans.
They really know what the fans want.
Man, I wish I could've gone to that.
I wanted to line up for Haruka just to tease her.
I'd love to see how she'd react to that.
But this time, Minori was the one who was really popular.
Thank you so much for your support!
I'm so glad more people came to the mini handshake event than I expected.
